text: 据霍尔果斯海关统计，今年上半年，依托区位与通道优势，全国最大商品车陆路出口口岸——霍尔果斯口岸汽车出口贸易持续升温，出口汽车21.9万辆，同比增长25.7%，出口总量、增速均创同期新高，成为新疆外贸提质增效的核心增长点。
text_en: According to Horgos Customs, in first half of the year, leveraging its location and corridor advantages, China's largest land port for finished vehicle export - Horgos port saw car export trade continue to heat up, exporting 219,000 vehicles, up 25.7% year-on-year, with total exports and growth rate hitting new highs for the period, becoming a core growth driver for Xinjiang's foreign trade quality and efficiency improvement.
